scripts.dev: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev -w @luch/api" "npm run dev -w @luch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run build -w @luch/api && npm run build -w @luch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/check-locales.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run db:migrate -w @luch/api
scripts.db:smoke: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run db:smoke -w @luch/api
scripts.db:verify-smoke: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run db:verify-smoke -w @luch/api
scripts.db:seed-demo: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run db:seed-demo -w @luch/api
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.content:seed-demo: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run content:seed-demo -w @luch/api
scripts.learning:recover: npm run build -w @luch/contracts && npm run learning:recover -w @luch/api
